judged_text: createAllCalendarEvents has no else branch when a destination's credential cannot be resolved (absent from this.calendarCredentials and the DB fetch returns nothing or lacks app.slug), so that destination is skipped with no error, warning, or result entry. A collective booking where one host's calendar credential was deleted or its app row is missing creates calendar events for the remaining hosts only while the booking reports complete success — the affected host's calendar silently never receives the event.

adjudication.rationale: In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, when iterating `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)`, the code tries to resolve a credential from `this.calendarCredentials`, then falls back to a Prisma fetch and only builds a `credential` if `credentialFromDB && credentialFromDB.app?.slug`. If both resolution paths fail, execution simply falls through without pushing any failure `EventResult` or logging (there is no `else` for the unresolved-credential case). As a result, that destination calendar is silently skipped and no calendar event is created for it, while other destinations may still succeed.
